title: Orbit Summit recap
brief:
An issue of Orbit's newsletter, The Orbit Dispatch, made with Orbit's newsletter kit (see CLAUDE.md for its rules).

- Preview text: "The talks, slides and demos from Orbit Summit."
- Heading: "Orbit Summit recap"
- Intro: "Two days, thirty talks and one very long demo. Here's what you missed."
- Two stories, one after the other. Each is an image, a title, a sentence and a button:
  - Image https://assets.orbit.dev/img/event-hero.png (1200×600 file), alt text "The Orbit Summit stage". Title "Watch every talk". Text "All thirty talks are online, with captions and chapters.". Button "Watch the talks" to https://orbit.dev/summit/talks?utm_source=newsletter.
  - Image https://assets.orbit.dev/img/gradient.png (1200×500 file), alt text "A slide from the keynote". Title "Slides and code". Text "Every deck and demo repository, in one place.". Button "Get the slides" to https://orbit.dev/summit/slides?utm_source=newsletter.
- Orbit's header (the logo) and footer (the address, and the unsubscribe link) are the kit's: use them as they are.
